summary: STMicroelectronics filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly repurchases under its previously announced buyback program, executed via a broker on Euronext Paris between October 5 and 9, 2026. The company bought 346,538 ordinary shares, or 0.04% of issued capital, at a weighted average of EUR 49.2425 for EUR 17,064,401.16. The program was approved by shareholder resolution dated May 22, 2024 and the supervisory board, primarily to satisfy employee share-option obligations. Post-repurchase treasury holdings total 15,930,103 shares, about 1.7% of capital. Watch continued weekly disclosure cadence and any acceleration in buyback pace or treasury overhang.
